method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: Run 41557723708 (38533cc0e: reporting-service and leetcode-auth-cookie-capture refactors, two image builds) breached `cpuSecondsPerRun` with 1048 against 1000; every job was green and the wall time was 10m41s. Single-leg runs this session (8m04s to 8m46s) stayed under 1000.

rows: - Run 41557723708 (38533cc0e: reporting-service and leetcode-auth-cookie-capture refactors, two image builds) breached `cpuSecondsPerRun` with 1048 against 1000; every job was green and the wall time was 10m41s. Single-leg runs this session (8m04s to 8m46s) stayed under 1000.

- Decision: `cpuSecondsPerExtraDeploy: 500` in `.github/ci-budget.json`; the ceiling is `cpuSecondsPerRun + (deploy legs - 1) * cpuSecondsPerExtraDeploy`, so a run is judged against the work it was asked to do. 500 is a first estimate (n=1, one two-leg run at 1048); revise once the budget job reports the measured CPU-seconds of more multi-leg runs.
